rows.en: (Lunchtime already, huh... What should I eat...)

Nah, it's nothing big.
I was just wondering what to eat for lunch.
What are you having, Akimizu?
Oh, I brought a lunch I made myself.
Oh, really? That's impressive.

Not at all. I mess up all the time.
I even burned the rolled omelet today...

Oh, I know!
If you'd like, do you want to share
this lunch with me?
Huh? Are you sure?

Yes. I made it for Claire-senpai, but it
looks like she's out today...
I didn't know what to do with it!
In that case, don't mind if I do!
(Akimizu's lunch was really good...)
(Lunchtime already. What should I eat...)

Oh, it's nothing big.
I was just wondering what to eat for lunch.
What are you having, Yuu?
Oh, really? That's impressive.
(Yuu's lunch was sooo good!)
(Well, classes are finally over for today...)
\p-kun, do you have a minute?
Oh, Akimizu. What's up?

Um, there's a part of the last class
I didn't quite catch.
Could you explain it to me, if you don't mind...?
rows.notes: Akimizu, both genders. Opening 'un' read as a hesitant 'um'.

rows.en: Oh, sure, if I can help.

I see...
I totally get it now. Thanks!

Don't mention it. But you're really
conscientious, Akimizu.

That's not true.
I even got a little sleepy in that class...
...Oops!?
rows.notes: Akimizu, both genders. She realizes she gave herself away.

rows.en: I see, so that's why you missed it...

(Akimizu's a serious student at heart,
though...)
(Well then, classes are finally over for today~)
\p-chan, do you have a minute?
Oh, Yuu. What's up?
Sure, if I can help.

Don't mention it. But you're really
conscientious, Yuu.
I see, so that's why you missed it...
(Yuu's a serious student at heart, though...)

(Hm? What's up with Akimizu?
She's been staring at Sheryl this whole time.)

What's wrong, Akimizu?
Sighing like that...
Oh! \p-kun...

No, I was just thinking how beautiful
Sheryl-san is...
Well, she IS the Galactic Fairy.
Sigh, I'm so jealous......
(Heh, Akimizu really is a girl after all.)

If I were... as beautiful as Sheryl-san,
Claire-senpai and I could be even more...!
rows.notes: Akimizu, both genders. Breaks off; she catches herself next line.

rows.en:
Uhhh...
W-well, I'd better get going!
Ah, Akimizu...

(Uhh...
A-Akimizu really does love Claire-senpai,
huh...)
rows.notes: Male. Suki: kept as 'love', as ambiguous as the Japanese.

rows.en:
(Hm? What's up with Yuu?
She's been staring at Sheryl-san this whole time.)

What's wrong, Yuu?
Sighing like that...
Oh! \p-chan...
(Heh, Yuu really is a girl after all.)
Ah, Yuu...

(Uhh...
Y-Yuu really does love Claire-senpai, huh...)

(Today's the day of Sheryl's concert!
I've been waiting forever!)
rows.notes: PLAYER, both genders. Also scd_ciz_701 and scd_sms_701.

rows.en:
(I'm finally going to meet Sheryl Nome,
the "Galactic Fairy"...)

(All right! I'm giving today's EX-Gear
acrobatics everything I've got!!)
(...Or so I was all fired up, but...)

(Who'd have thought an accident like that
would happen...)
That Alto, going off on his own like that...!

(Alto went off grandstanding and nearly
got Sheryl seriously hurt...)
rows.notes: Male. Also ciz/sms 701. Sutando-puree = grandstanding, as nml_alt_019.

rows.en:
(At least the concert managed to go on,
so that's something, but...)

At least no one got hurt.
That's the one silver lining.
But the crowd went totally wild, didn't they?

It's not about the crowd getting excited.
What bothers me is that he threw off
the whole team's harmony...
Huh? An explosion!?

This is the Macross Frontier Administrative Bureau.
An evacuation alert has been issued for all ships.
All citizens, please go to the shelters at once.
rows.notes: Operator; also scd_ciz_701, scd_sms_701, scd_tri_704. Opening matches the finished Ship Broadcast lines c21038/c21066 (slice 293: 'Macross Frontier government'); organizations.json has 'Frontier Administrative Bureau' (needs_research). Coordinator: gyouseifu 'Administrative Bureau' per organizations.json; c21038/c21066 aligned to the same opener.

rows.en: Even an evacuation alert!?
Roger. Returning immediately.
rows.notes: Kagura on his comm; the same row is Michel's in scd_ciz_701, scd_sms_701, scd_tri_704.

rows.en: Let's go, Shirakawa, Hoshimura.
Roger that~!

(I've gotta get to a shelter too...
Wait, where did Yuuto and the others go?)

Yuuto, Shirakawa, Hoshimura! Where do you
think you're going in an emergency like this!?
rows.notes: Male. Male player uses Yuuto, Shirakawa, Hoshimura.

rows.en:
Sorry, \p.
I just got called in by my part-time job...
rows.notes: Kagura, both genders. Matches Michel's sms_701 line.

rows.en:
No part-time job would call you in during
an emergency like this! Come on, we need to
get to a shelter too......
Well, that's what anyone would think...

There's no time to explain anyway,
so why don't we just drag 'em along?
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders; 'em' = the player, kept neutral.

rows.en: No way! That'd get us in serious trouble!

No... that might be for the best.
Gary-sensei did say he'd bring them along
one of these days.
rows.notes: Shirakawa, both genders; 'them' = the player, kept neutral since the row serves both.

rows.en: But...!

\p-kun,
would you come with us to our part-time job
right now?
rows.notes: Shirakawa, male scene; she asks the player.

rows.en: What!? At a time like this?

It's because it's a time like this
that we want you to come.

Because it's a time like this?
What kind of part-time job is it...?

uncertain: c20693: 'Macross Frontier government' matches the finished broadcasts c21038/c21066 in slice 293, while organizations.json lists frontier_government as 'Frontier Administrative Bureau' (needs_research); the two should be reconciled. Row shared with scd_ciz_701, scd_sms_701 and scd_tri_704.
c20703 / c20705: Hoshimura and Shirakawa refer to the player in a row shared by both genders; kept neutral ('em', 'them').
c20670: 'Claire-senpai and I could be even more...!' keeps her break-off; the Japanese only says 'with Claire-senpai more...'.
